'''Business and economy'''
*[[Daihatsu]], a subsidiary of [[Japan]]ese [[automaker]] [[Toyota]], suspends all production at its four factories in Japan amid a [[Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism|transport ministry]] investigation into [[Quality control|improper tests]] for [[safety certification]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-daihatsu-toyota-safety-scandal-shutdown-1e5808bd4fe335f585a9049a2cb64e0a (AP)]
*The [[Presidency of Javier Milei|administration]] of [[Argentina]]'s new [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Javier Milei]] says the [[Government of Argentina|government]] will not renew contracts for more than 5,000 employees hired this year before he took office, as part of plans for cutbacks to the government. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-milei-layoffs-cutbacks-economy-7dc274816cdea2fbed6242a39aa94a54 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**Twenty-two people are killed by [[flood]]s in [[Kasaï-Central]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. Several houses and structures are damaged, with a major road being cut off. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-flooding-kasai-rainfall-cb521113d3f4ed3e5355890359646391 (AP)]
*[[2023 Totota fire]]
**At least 40 people are killed during the explosion of a [[Tank truck|gas tanker]] in [[Totota]], [[Liberia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/28/dozens-killed-as-gas-tanker-explodes-in-liberia (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[structure fire|fire]] at a [[guest house]] in [[Prahova County|Prahova]], [[Romania]] leaves six people dead, two others injured, and several others missing. [https://www.euronews.ro/articole/incendiu-puternic-la-o-pensiune-din-prahova-a-fost-activat-planul-rosu-de-interve (Euronews)] [https://apnews.com/article/romania-guesthouse-fire-dead-95a9e2f2cb74fa412d8f09728f1d018c (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] says that [[Iran]] has reversed a slowdown of its [[enriched uranium|enrichment]] of [[uranium]], and is now enriching uranium at up to 60%, bringing the country closer to reaching the enrichment level required to make a [[nuclear weapon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-undoes-slowdown-enrichment-uranium-near-weapons-grade-iaea-2023-12-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Fukushima nuclear accident]]
**The [[Tokyo High Court]] rules that [[Tokyo Electric Power Company|TEPCO]], the operator of the [[Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant|Fukushima nuclear power plant]], will be solely responsible for [[Financial compensation|compensating]] evacuees and reduced the amount to half the amount a lower court initially ordered, while also absolving the [[Government of Japan|government]] of any liability. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-fukushima-nuclear-ruling-evacuees-compensation-tepco-a844a85ecdff3e2526e81e242d4c89ed (AP)]
*A man is arrested in [[Sevres]], [[Île-de-France]], [[France]], for killing his four children and their [[Haitians in France|Haitian]] mother at their flat in [[Meaux]] the day before. [https://apnews.com/article/france-family-killed-father-arrested-bdbd246a5acedc11ac64ed17a067c024 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 NBA season]]
**In [[basketball]], the [[Detroit Pistons]] lose their [[2023–24 Detroit Pistons season|27th consecutive game]] and break the [[List of National Basketball Association longest losing streaks|single-season record]] for the most consecutive losses in a [[National Basketball Association]] regular season, surpassing the records set by the [[2010–11 Cleveland Cavaliers season|2010–11 Cleveland Cavaliers]] and [[2013–14 Philadelphia 76ers season|2013–14 Philadelphia 76ers]], who both lost 26 straight games. [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/nba/pistons/2023/12/26/one-for-the-ages-pistons-set-nba-record-with-27th-straight-loss-against-nets/72030210007/ (''The Detroit News'')]
